t: 加那利群岛的主岛大加那利岛被卡斯蒂利亚王国征服.
te: Gran Canaria, the main island of the Canary Islands, is conquered by the Kingdom of Castile.
dz: 加那利群岛的主岛大加那利岛被卡斯蒂利亚王国征服.
de: Gran Canaria, the main island of the Canary Islands, is conquered by the Kingdom of Castile.

t: 理查三世成为了英格兰国王.
te: Richard III becomes King of England.
dz: 理查三世成为了英格兰国王.
de: Richard III becomes King of England.

t: 理查三世和安妮·内维尔被加冕为英国国王和女王.
te: Richard III and Anne Neville are crowned King and Queen of England.
dz: 理查三世和安妮·内维尔被加冕为英国国王和女王.
de: Richard III and Anne Neville are crowned King and Queen of England.

t: 教宗斯克多斯四世册封了西斯廷礼拜堂.
te: Pope Sixtus IV consecrates the Sistine Chapel.
dz: 教宗斯克多斯四世册封了西斯廷礼拜堂.
de: Pope Sixtus IV consecrates the Sistine Chapel.

t: 在奥斯曼政府的影响下,保皇党人西米翁一世在君士坦丁堡召集了东正教会的统领会,确定了接纳天主教徒…
te: Under the influence of the Ottoman government, patriarch Symeon I convenes a synod of the Eastern Orthodox Churches in …
dz: 在奥斯曼政府的影响下,保皇党人西米翁一世在君士坦丁堡召集了东正教会的统领会,确定了接纳天主教徒加入东正教会的仪式并谴责了费拉拉-弗洛伦斯的教会联盟.
de: Under the influence of the Ottoman government, patriarch Symeon I convenes a synod of the Eastern Orthodox Churches in Constantinople which defines the ritual for admitting Catholics to the Eastern Orthodox Churches and condemns the church union of Ferrara-Florence.
